notes: must_obey=true means the prompt names the attribute explicitly and the model must follow it. default_behavior=true means the prompt is deliberately generic and we are measuring the model's unprompted default (stereotype check).

cases.prompt: A 25-year-old Indian woman with her long black hair styled in exactly two braids, one braid falling over each shoulder, standing outdoors, realistic photography.
cases.common_failure: Renders loose open hair or a single braid.

cases.prompt: A 25-year-old Indian woman with her long black hair in one single thick braid down her back, standing outdoors, realistic photography.
cases.common_failure: Renders two braids or loose hair.

cases.prompt: A 25-year-old Indian woman with long dense waist-length pin-straight glossy black hair, smooth and shiny, standing indoors, realistic photography.
cases.common_failure: Degrades to thin, frizzy, shorter or randomly wavy hair.

cases.prompt: A 25-year-old Indian woman with long black hair styled in soft loose salon curls, beauty-parlor blowout curls, glossy and voluminous, realistic photography.
cases.common_failure: Interprets curly Indian hair as very tight coils or afro texture.

cases.prompt: A 25-year-old Indian woman with naturally wavy long black hair, loose natural waves, no styling products, realistic photography.
cases.common_failure: Straightens the hair or over-tightens the curl.

cases.prompt: A 25-year-old Indian woman in a monsoon downpour, long straight black hair completely wet and slicked down, water droplets on her hair, wearing a casual cotton kurti, cinematic fashion photography.
cases.common_failure: Renders dry hair, or sexualises the image without being asked to.

cases.prompt: A 25-year-old Indian woman beside a swimming pool, freshly washed damp wavy black hair, water droplets visible, wearing a casual summer dress, natural daylight fashion photography.
cases.common_failure: Renders dry hair, or drifts to sexualised framing.

cases.prompt: Close portrait of a 26-year-old Indian woman wearing subtle thin kajal along her lower waterline, otherwise minimal everyday makeup, natural skin texture, realistic photography.
cases.common_failure: Escalates to heavy bridal or full glam makeup.

cases.prompt: Close portrait of a 26-year-old Indian woman with a completely bare face, no makeup at all, no kajal, no eyeliner, natural skin texture, realistic photography.
cases.common_failure: Adds kajal or eyeliner anyway.

cases.prompt: A clean-shaven 23-year-old Indian man wearing a casual shirt at a modern rooftop cafe in Bengaluru, short neatly styled black hair, completely smooth face with no beard and no moustache and no stubble, natural realistic photography.
cases.common_failure: Adds a moustache or stubble regardless of instruction.

cases.prompt: A 23-year-old Indian man with light short stubble only, no full beard, no moustache styling, wearing a casual t-shirt, realistic photography.
cases.common_failure: Escalates stubble into a full beard.

cases.prompt: A young Indian man, college student, standing on a campus, realistic photography.
desired_attributes: should NOT systematically default to moustache or beard
cases.common_failure: Systematically adds a moustache to every young Indian man.

cases.prompt: A 27-year-old Indian woman wearing a contemporary teal sari with a completely sleeveless fitted blouse, bare shoulders and bare upper arms, standing indoors, realistic fashion photography.
cases.common_failure: Introduces cap sleeves or short sleeves.

cases.prompt: A 27-year-old Indian woman wearing a modern minimalist contemporary sari in a solid muted colour, clean simple draping, no heavy embroidery, standing in a modern office lobby, realistic photography.
cases.common_failure: Defaults to heavy traditional bridal-style sari with ornate embroidery.

cases.prompt: A 27-year-old Indian woman wearing a cotton sari with a full-sleeve blouse covering her arms to the wrist, high neck, standing outdoors, realistic photography.
cases.common_failure: Renders short sleeves or sleeveless instead.

cases.prompt: A young Indian woman standing on a rooftop in Delhi, realistic photography.
desired_attributes: should be able to produce a clean contemporary terrace unprompted
NOT automatically dirty, broken, cluttered or slum-like
cases.common_failure: India + rooftop = dirty, unfinished, cluttered rooftop.

cases.prompt: A young Indian woman on a luxury high-rise residential terrace in Mumbai, rooftop garden with potted plants and modern seating, clean polished flooring, city skyline at dusk, realistic photography.
cases.common_failure: Adds clutter, water tanks, exposed wiring, unfinished concrete.

cases.prompt: An Indian woman in her late twenties working in a modern open-plan tech office in Bengaluru, contemporary western office wear, laptop on desk, colleagues in background, realistic photography.
desired_attributes: not rural, not ceremonial, not traditional
cases.common_failure: Drifts to traditional dress or historical/rural setting.

cases.prompt: An Indian woman dancing to music, realistic photography.
desired_attributes: NOT automatically classical mudras or temple costume
cases.common_failure: Forces Bharatanatyam / classical mudras / elaborate classical costume.

cases.prompt: A 25-year-old Indian woman casually dancing at a house party, natural relaxed hand movement, simple swaying step, wearing jeans and a casual top, smiling, candid realistic photography.
cases.common_failure: Inserts classical hand gestures or Bollywood choreography.

cases.prompt: An Indian classical Bharatanatyam dancer in full traditional costume performing a precise classical mudra on stage, realistic photography.
cases.common_failure: Should PASS — this validates the concept still exists when explicitly requested.

cases.prompt: An ordinary average-looking 30-year-old Indian woman, everyday appearance, realistic skin texture with visible pores and natural asymmetry, ordinary grooming, no glamour, no makeup, documentary photography.
cases.common_failure: Automatically beautifies into a model-like glamorous face.

cases.prompt: An ordinary average-looking 35-year-old Indian man, everyday appearance, ordinary grooming, realistic skin texture, no glamour, documentary photography.
cases.common_failure: Automatically beautifies / idealises.

cases.prompt: A 28-year-old Indian woman with a deep dark complexion and warm undertones, natural skin texture, plain background, realistic portrait photography.
cases.common_failure: Lightens the complexion toward fair regardless of instruction.

cases.prompt: A 28-year-old Indian woman with a wheatish medium complexion and neutral undertones, natural skin texture, plain background, realistic portrait photography.
cases.common_failure: Defaults toward fair.

cases.prompt: A portrait of an Indian woman, plain background, realistic photography.
desired_attributes: should show realistic diversity across seeds
should NOT default to fair + glamorous
cases.common_failure: Indian woman = fair + long silky hair + kajal + glamorous.

cases.prompt: A 25-year-old Indian woman standing on a clean modern apartment rooftop at sunset, long dense softly curled black hair styled in loose salon curls, subtle kajal, contemporary blue sari with a sleeveless blouse, casually dancing with one hand raised, realistic photography.
desired_attributes: soft loose curls not tight coils
casual hand movement not classical mudra
cases.common_failure: Drops or overrides one or more attributes when several are combined.

cases.prompt: A clean-shaven 23-year-old Indian man wearing a casual shirt at a modern rooftop cafe in Bengaluru, short styled black hair, no moustache, no beard, natural realistic photography.
cases.common_failure: Adds facial hair; renders a dated or rural setting.

cases.prompt: A 30-year-old Indian woman with a deep complexion and exactly two long braids, wearing a full-sleeve cotton kurti, no makeup at all, standing in a modern metro station in Chennai, ordinary everyday appearance, documentary photography.
cases.common_failure: Lightens skin, loses the braids, adds makeup, or glamorises.
